component.name: FetchEpgTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetchEpg" end sub
sub fetchEpg() m.top.state = "loading" url = m.top.url if url = "" or url = invalid m.top.error = "No EPG URL provided" m.top.state = "error" return end if
' Cache EPG for 6 hours (21600 seconds) settings = LoadEpgSettings() ttl = settings.ttlHours * 3600
' ── Proxy mode: route through StreamShōgun API for .gz support ── fetchUrl = url cacheKey = "epg_data" if m.top.useProxy and m.top.proxyBaseUrl <> "" and m.top.proxyToken <> "" fetchUrl = BuildEpgProxyUrl(m.top.proxyBaseUrl, m.top.url) cacheKey = "epg_proxy" SafeLog("EPG", "Using proxy endpoint for EPG fetch") end if
if m.top.useProxy and m.top.proxyToken <> "" result = HttpGetWithAuth(fetchUrl, cacheKey, ttl, m.top.proxyToken) else result = HttpGet(fetchUrl, cacheKey, ttl) end if if not result.ok m.top.error = "Failed to download EPG. " + IIF(result.error <> invalid, result.error, "Check URL or network.") m.top.state = "error" return end if
' Update last fetch time settings.lastFetch = CreateObject("roDateTime").AsSeconds() SaveEpgSettings(settings)
epgData = ParseXMLTV(result.body) if epgData.channels.Count() = 0 errorMsg = "No EPG data found. Check that the URL points to valid XMLTV data." if not m.top.useProxy errorMsg = errorMsg + " If the file is .xml.gz, enable the EPG Proxy in Settings (Pro required)." end if m.top.error = errorMsg m.top.state = "error" return end if
m.top.epgData = epgData m.top.state = "done" end sub
